mapper.sql: d.id, d.tenant_id tenantId, d.type_code typeCode, d.dict_code dictCode, d.dict_name dictName, d.dict_value dictValue, d.value_type valueType, d.value_parser valueParser, d.dict_order dictOrder, d.is_default isDefault, d.css, d.status, d.remark, d.create_by createBy, d.create_time createTime, d.update_by updateBy, d.update_time updateTime, t.type_name typeName, t.module_code moduleCode, m.module_name moduleName

select
from sys_dict d left join sys_dict_type t on d.type_code = t.type_code and d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id left join sys_module m on t.module_code = m.module_code and t.tenant_id = m.tenant_id where d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and d.id = #{id}
